pairs.subject: quality-regression-gating
pairs.evidence: crates/runner/src/rubric.rs:382 The runner tests a scalar baseline without validating the conditions under which that measurement was established.

techniques.evidence: crates/runner/src/rubric.rs:382 The floor receives only the numeric baseline and current summary, with no baseline provenance predicate.
crates/runner/src/stats/normal.rs:105 Compare mode supplies the target count; verdict artifacts disclose the correction, threshold, family size and power cost.
crates/runner/src/stats/paired.rs:25 The decision level is compiled into the verdict module and has no inspected runtime setting.

crates/runner/src/compare.rs:873 Case identity alignment and subset disclosure are implemented, but the history selector receives no current judge identity and its filter does not require matching judges.

crates/runner/src/util.rs:320 A halted comparison containing a completed regressed target becomes regressed rather than unverified; the standard prohibits both green and regression verdicts for partial runs.

crates/runner/src/compare.rs:1225 The winner is tested with case pairing and all-pairs correction, but its claim exists in the printed matrix summary created after the per-target reports were posted, rather than being persisted with the run.
crates/runner/src/gate.rs:9 The status mapper distinguishes regression code 3, unverified code 4 and success code 0; main activates it only under --gate.

pairs.subject: quality-regression-gating
pairs.evidence: crates/api/src/benchmarks.rs:216 Benchmark creation stores an unqualified scalar baseline, leaving subsequent gates unable to establish its measurement conditions.

techniques.evidence: crates/api/src/benchmarks.rs:216 The API records no baseline source run, setter or measured instrument and dataset revision; its later predicate accepts missing pins and compares run pins against current benchmark settings.
crates/api/src/prompts_gate.rs:191 Promotion can add a regression block using report.ci95, the uncorrected interval, even when a multi-target runner verdict passed at the corrected threshold.

crates/api/src/prompts_gate.rs:157 Without a baseline, regression_refusal returns before examining incomplete status, allowing a resolved partial or cancelled run to promote without reporting its partiality.
crates/api/src/quality.rs:10 The inspected API surfaces expose measurements and stored run payloads without making a model-winner claim.
crates/api/src/benchmarks.rs:438 Unrecognized run statuses submitted across the HTTP boundary can fall through to a passing scalar comparison instead of becoming unverified.

pairs.subject: quality-regression-gating
pairs.evidence: crates/core/src/score.rs:443 The benchmark data model represents its baseline mean as a scalar without a record of the conditions that make comparison defensible.

techniques.evidence: crates/core/src/score.rs:443 The complete Benchmark definition has no baseline source-run, setter or baseline-specific judge and dataset revision record.
